questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs with yellow and black markings warn about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed. You must follow the rules shown on regulation signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful as you go through the intersection. You do not need to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with black markings on white background. You must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided into separate lanes. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions or hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to turn or watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance. It shows how much space there is between the road and a bridge or overpass above it (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular yellow sign with black lettering means no passing. You will see it on the left side of two-lane roads where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a side road is coming up and traffic may enter from that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop. Look all around for traffic before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: The road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road has a sharp curve in the direction the arrow points. Multiple chevron signs may be placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits and you must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road may be slippery when wet. Be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The road ahead has a series of turns and curves.
